decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed retention of the two-storey side extension, single-storey rear extension to span the full width of the house as extended, and the erection of a front porch, due to their position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of 73 Broad Walk and would be compatible with the visual amenity of the locality, and would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties or result in conditions prejudicial to highway safety. On balance, the development is in accordance with Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) policies ENV-B.1.1, H.6.4, T.1.4 and the Residential Extension Guidelines (July 2002).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions and porch hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extensions are used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east and west walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The extensions hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for the purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 73 Broad Walk Heston.
description: Erection of two storey side extension, single storey rear extension and part single storey side extension and front entrance porch to dwellinghouse.
